output.patientMessage: Go to the emergency department now. New trouble breathing when lying flat, together with two weeks of worsening swelling in both ankles, can mean fluid building up from a heart or related problem and needs same-hour tests and treatment. Have someone drive you rather than driving yourself. If you become severely breathless at rest, have chest pain, or faint, call 911 immediately.
